text:
maria: Quick async status on token-cost attribution pipeline — short check for owners/deps before Friday sync.

maria: TL;DR: schema v2 merged in analytics (events/token_attrib.v2), canary ingest running in prod-us-west, smoke looks mostly good but we saw a small latency bump on long-tail tokens. Need reviewers + eng-sre on circuit-breaker for canary window.

noah: I can take PR #4321 (schema migration + adaptor). Will do a pass today and flag anything breaking.

sydney: Canary metrics: 95th p99 for attribution enrichment went from 220ms -> 310ms on one shard. Not a producer issue, looks like prefix cache miss. I pushed a heatmap sample to the bucket: gs://redwood-telemetry/canary/274912.

rahul: @maria I can own the circuit-breaker and traffic steering for the canary. Need the runbook link + target SLO for the window. If we hit >5% token error or >500ms p99 we kill canary.

maria: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/telemetry-canary (added). SLO: p99 < 400ms, error rate < 1% of ingest requests. Circuit-breaker trigger: 3 consecutive 5-min buckets above thresholds.

jen: flagged infra dep — eng-infra needs to bump kafka retention for the replay window; ticket INFRA-1987 in their queue. @noah can you add replay sensitivity notes to the PR?

noah: added a note in PR and linked INFRA-1987. Also: two small requests from analytics side that need review: (1) add token_type field to event (backwards-compatible), (2) normalize cost_unit to "micro_token".

maria: both sound fine, we prefer additive fields only. If anyone sees a downstream consumer relying on old shape, call it out now.

sydney: Quick sample query for the heatmap (copied here):
```
SELECT bucket, avg(latency_ms) AS p50 FROM telemetry.token_ingest
WHERE run_id = 'canary-274912'
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket;
```

maria: smoke test command (use CANARY token):
```
# smoke test ingest
curl -X POST https://canary-ingest.internal/api/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"request_id":"smoke-1","prompt":"hello world","tokens":8}'
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded — canary-2026-03-15T14:22Z (image: telemetry-ingest:v2.1-canary).

rahul: ran manual smoke and replayed ~1k messages, saw 0 errors, p99 ~ 340ms. Will wire up circuit-breaker rule by EOD.

noah: I'll finish code review and merge after rahul's CB is live. Leaving checklist here: 1) CB rule deployed (rahul), 2) infra retention confirmed (eng-infra), 3) two analytics field requests merged (noah), 4) post-merge canary monitor for 24h (maria).

jen: added a 30m block on Friday for cross-team rundown. Calendar invite sent.

maria: thanks all — ping here if you see regressions. If no objections I'll merge schema adapter after rahul confirms CB. :thumbsup:
